plain_text:
The Inclusive Forum on Carbon Mitigation Approaches (IFCMA) is supporting the development of
interoperable carbon intensity metrics as essential tools for identifying carbon leakage risks. These
metrics quantify the greenhouse gas emissions associated with the production of goods and services.
To enable standardised comparisons of emissions performance across jurisdictions, carbon intensity
metrics must be interoperable. Interoperable metrics provide the data backbone for emissions
tandards and border carbon adjustment mechanisms, such as the European Union (EU) Carbon
Border Adjustment Mechanisms (CBAM). Applying carbon intensity metrics, such policies can be
implemented to disincentivise emissions outsourcing and align trade flows with the goals of the Paris
Agreement.
